topics.title: Dissolution of partnership and dissolution of the firm

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the events that dissolve a partnership while the firm may continue its business.
Distinguish dissolution of partnership from dissolution of a firm on business, settlement, court role and books.

topics.title: Modes of dissolution of a firm

concepts.learning_objective: Explain dissolution by agreement and on the happening of contingencies such as expiry of term or completion of a venture.
State the cases in which a firm is compulsorily dissolved.
Explain dissolution by notice in a partnership at will and the grounds on which a court may order dissolution.
Apply the order in which losses and capital deficiencies are met, including the Garner vs. Murray rule.
Apply the Section 48 order of paying outside debts, partners' loans, capitals and the residue.
Apply the Section 49 rules on firm's debts and partners' private debts.
Identify which assets and liabilities are transferred to the Realisation Account and on which side.
Compute profit or loss on realisation and its transfer to partners' capital accounts.
Record realisation expenses and remuneration under different arrangements with partners.
Record assets taken over and liabilities assumed by partners, and settlements with creditors.
Record the final settlement of partners' loans and capital accounts.
